explication: This repository provides four ways to decrypt WeChat Channels videos: a browser tool, Python CLI, Python GUI, and REST API. The core workflow is obtaining a decode key and encrypted video, generating or supplying a 128 KB keystream, XOR-decrypting the encrypted prefix, validating the MP4, and saving or returning the result. The README documents the browser/API capabilities; some browser and worker internals were not sampled, so only documented or excerpt-supported relationships are shown.
